title: feat(plugin-grid,console): list cells show the record a referenceVia pointer names; the empty inbox says who else is waiting
body:
Part of #12608
Clause-②: yes

This is the objectui half of the card. The column set, the step and flow labels, Waiting on and the Action History record column are producer work on objectstack-ai/objectstack. They are listed under Producer proposals, so this PR does not close the card.

## What changed

**Target 1 and 2 (objectui half): the pointer cell.** In `ObjectGrid`, a column for a `text` field that declares `referenceVia` now draws the record the row's pointer pair names: the target object's icon and the record's name. The raw id moves to the tooltip. The pair is resolved per row by the existing `resolveRecordPointer` from `@object-ui/fields`, the same rule the record details grid uses. The new cell, `RecordPointerCell` in plugin-grid, only draws what that rule returns. The name comes from `getRecordDisplayName` after `withoutDeniedFields`. The page's targets are read with one `find` per target object, using an `id` `$in` filter; object definitions come from `getObjectSchema`. Both answers are cached per data source. The face is wired into all four column paths of the grid, so every `referenceVia` field in every list gets it: `sys_approval_request.record_id`, `sys_activity.source_id`, and the sharing, audit and mail pointers.

**Target 4.** A target that cannot be read shows `Opportunity · record unavailable`, with the id only in the tooltip. Deleted records, rows outside the viewer's access, an unavailable definition and failed reads all get this one rendering, for the same no-existence-oracle reason `RecordPreviewCard` gives.

**Target 3.** When the caller's pending tab in the Approvals Inbox is empty, the page sends one count query: `listRequests` with status pending and `limit` 1, so the server returns `total`. The server counts under the same visibility as the All tab's own read. If the total is above zero, the empty state adds one muted line: `N requests are waiting on other approvers · Browse all requests`. The existing Browse all requests control moves into that line, so it still appears once. If the count read fails, no line is shown.

New language-pack keys in all ten shipped locales: `grid.recordUnavailable` and the `approvalsInbox.waitingOnOthers` plural family, with the CLDR categories each language needs.

## Deviations

- **Names are not links in console lists yet.** The cell links through the host's `recordHref` / `openRecord`, and a unit test pins the link. The console list host, `listRecordActionsValue` in app-shell `ObjectView.tsx`, deliberately answers `recordHref` only for the object being listed, so in Setup the name renders without a link. That is outside this claim's files, and changing it would also turn every lookup cell in every list into a link. It is left to the seat.
- Browse all requests keeps its existing destination, the inbox's All tab, which reads the same approvals door as the count. It does not point to the object list view.
- New language-pack keys can be reached from the `@object-ui/i18n` entry. The claim's file surface names them; the seat decides whether Clause-② covers them. No export, prop or type member is added; `RecordPointerCell` is internal to plugin-grid.

## Producer proposals (objectstack)

- Step label: `sys_approval_request.current_step` and `sys_approval_action.step_name` store the node id (`manager_review`). The engine should write a label snapshot when it opens or advances a step, and the list views should show that instead.
- Flow label: `process_name` is `flow:NAME`. The engine should write a `process_label` snapshot of the flow's label, keeping the api name in `process_name`.
- Waiting on: `pending_approvers` is a textarea of slot addresses. It needs an engine-served display column, resolved by the approvals service's own resolver, in `all_requests` and `my_pending`.
- Action History record column: `request_id` displays the request's `display_title` formula, which is `process_name · record_id`, so the raw id leaks. Add the pointer pair (`object_name` and `record_id` with `referenceVia`) to `sys_approval_action`; this PR's cell then draws it.
- Action History `acted_as` shows a raw user id. It needs a served display label.

## Screenshots (HotCRM, 1280 px)

- Approval Requests, light: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/d2979a6e56cfe7fc3df5537e01c0023664c28212/docs/design/findings/12608/approval-requests-light.png?raw=true
- Approval Requests, dark: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/d2979a6e56cfe7fc3df5537e01c0023664c28212/docs/design/findings/12608/approval-requests-dark.png?raw=true
- Action History, light: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/d2979a6e56cfe7fc3df5537e01c0023664c28212/docs/design/findings/12608/action-history-light.png?raw=true
- Action History, dark: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/d2979a6e56cfe7fc3df5537e01c0023664c28212/docs/design/findings/12608/action-history-dark.png?raw=true
- Approvals Inbox, light: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/d2979a6e56cfe7fc3df5537e01c0023664c28212/docs/design/findings/12608/approvals-inbox-light.png?raw=true
- Approvals Inbox, dark: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/d2979a6e56cfe7fc3df5537e01c0023664c28212/docs/design/findings/12608/approvals-inbox-dark.png?raw=true

Record cells read from the DOM at capture, first three rows of `all_requests`:
1. unreadable, `Opportunity · record unavailable`, title `SzIsIKdI_MYlObTf` (its opportunity was deleted)
2. readable, `Globex Manufacturing Suite`, title `28W5lzLQhZs_53LL`, icon `lucide-dollar-sign`
3. readable, `Initech Cloud Migration`, title `9C2hdzZMz96ZbHzk`, icon `lucide-dollar-sign`

The 50-row page sent exactly one `crm_opportunity` data request. The inbox read `52 requests are waiting on other approvers · Browse all requests`: 53 requests, one of them cancelled.

About the seed: a fresh HotCRM boot (`e50d048`) has no approval requests. I created 53 through the flows by raising 10 open deals to $100K or more and adding 43 new ones. I then ran `pnpm demo:staff`, reassigned the admin's 10 slots to the sales manager, and deleted one target.

## Test evidence (head b04cf2e)

- New pins: `ObjectGrid.recordPointerCell-12608` 3/3 passed; `ApprovalsInboxPage.waitingOnOthers-12608` 3/3 passed. Each pin was ablated once and went red: pointer face off, 2 failed; unreadable cell prints the id, 1 failed; line never drawn, 1 failed; line always drawn, 2 failed. Each mutant was restored to HEAD.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`: 1437 files passed, 13596 tests passed, exit 0.
- plugin-grid, fields and i18n suites: 560 files, 7431 tests passed, exit 0. apps/console: 206 files, 2191 tests passed, exit 0.
- type-check (plugin-grid, fields, i18n, console), eslint on touched files (0 errors), the console closure build plus the console build, and check:i18n-keys, i18n-drift, i18n-designer-parity, changeset presence: all exit 0.
